name: Residence Permit for the Purpose of Study

requirements.blocker_text: Must establish a learning relationship with a public education institution, or pursue full-time studies at a state-recognised higher education institution in Hungary.
requirements.fix_path: Secure enrollment at a qualifying institution.

requirements.blocker_text: Must document ability to cover subsistence, accommodation, return/onward travel, and healthcare costs (bank statements, employer income letters, or scholarship certificates).

evidence_required.document: Letter of acceptance from a qualifying institution
Proof of funds (bank statement, income letter, or scholarship certificate)
Health insurance or Hungarian social security eligibility

outcome.duration_length: 1-3 years tied to training length, extendable for a further 1-3 years

sources.title: National Directorate-General for Aliens Policing (OIF) -- Residence of the Student, Pupil: enrollment, funds, health insurance, accommodation declaration, 30h/week or 90-day work limits, family reunification bar

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Hungary's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1. work_rights set to 'restricted': holders may work a maximum of 30 hours/week during study periods, or full-time up to 90 days/year outside study periods. family_can_join set false: the source states student permit holders 'shall not be granted a residence permit for the purpose of family reunification,' with a narrow exception for children born in Hungary during the permit's validity.
